name: rotate two parallel support lines around the hull, advancing whichever has the smaller angle to its next edge
mechanism: rest two parallel lines on opposite vertices of a convex polygon; rotate both together, at each step turning by the smaller of the two angles needed to reach the next edge and advancing that vertex; every pair of opposite vertices is visited once, in one pass around the polygon

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Rotating calipers' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: determine all antipodal pairs of points and vertices on a convex polygon or convex hull.
